section.title: org.osgi.service.usbinfo
section.para: USB Information Device Category Specification Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.usbinfo; version="[1.0,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.usbinfo; version="[1.0,1.1)"}

section.title: public abstract USBInfoDevice
section.para: Represents a USB device. For each USB device, an object is registered with the framework under the USBInfoDevice interface. A USB information base driver must implement this interface.
The values of the USB property names are defined by the USB Implementers Forum, Inc.

section.title: public static final String DEVICE_CATEGORY = "USBInfo"
section.para: Constant for the value of the service property {@code DEVICE_CATEGORY} used for all USB devices.
A USB information base driver bundle must set this property key.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_CLASS = 10
section.para: Device Access match value indicating a match with {@link #USB_BDEVICECLASS} or a match with {@link #USB_BINTERFACECLASS}.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_MODEL = 40
section.para: Device Access match value indicating a match with {@link #USB_IDVENDOR}, and {@link #USB_IDPRODUCT}.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_PROTOCOL = 30
section.para: Device Access match value indicating a match with {@link #USB_BDEVICECLASS}, {@link #USB_BDEVICESUBCLASS}, and {@link #USB_BDEVICEPROTOCOL} or a match with {@link #USB_BINTERFACECLASS} , {@link #USB_BINTERFACESUBCLASS}, and {@link #USB_BINTERFACEPROTOCOL}.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_SUBCLASS = 20
section.para: Device Access match value indicating a match with {@link #USB_BDEVICECLASS}, and {@link #USB_BDEVICESUBCLASS} or a match with {@link #USB_BINTERFACECLASS}, and {@link #USB_BINTERFACESUBCLASS}.

section.title: public static final int MATCH_VERSION = 50
section.para: Device Access match value indicating a match with {@link #USB_IDVENDOR}, {@link #USB_IDPRODUCT}, and {@link #USB_BCDDEVICE}.

section.title: public static final String USB_ADDRESS = "usbinfo.address"
section.para: Service property to identify USB address.

Used to identify USB devices with same VID / PID. The value is the ID of the USB address assigned when connecting the USB device. USB address is an integer in the range 1-127 and does not change while the USB device remains connected. The value type is Integer.

section.title: public static final String USB_BALTERNATESETTING = "usbinfo.bAlternateSetting"
section.para: Service property for USB Interface Descriptor field "bAlternateSetting".
The value type is Integer. This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_BCDDEVICE = "usbinfo.bcdDevice"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "bcdDevice".
The value type is String; the value is in 4-digit BCD format. For example, "0200".

section.title: public static final String USB_BCDUSB = "usbinfo.bcdUSB"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "bcdUSB".
The value type is String; the value is in 4-digit BCD format. For example, "0210". This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_BDEVICECLASS = "usbinfo.bDeviceClass"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "bDeviceClass".
The value type is String; the value is in 2-digit hexadecimal. For example, "ff".

section.title: public static final String USB_BDEVICEPROTOCOL = "usbinfo.bDeviceProtocol"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "bDeviceProtocol".
The value type is String; the value is in 2-digit hexadecimal. For example, "ff".

section.title: public static final String USB_BDEVICESUBCLASS = "usbinfo.bDeviceSubClass"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "bDeviceSubClass".
The value type is String; the value is in 2-digit hexadecimal. For example, "ff".

section.title: public static final String USB_BINTERFACECLASS = "usbinfo.bInterfaceClass"
section.para: Service property for USB Interface Descriptor field "bInterfaceClass".
The value type is String; the value is in 2-digit hexadecimal. For example, "ff".

section.title: public static final String USB_BINTERFACENUMBER = "usbinfo.bInterfaceNumber"
section.para: Service property for USB Interface Descriptor field "bInterfaceNumber".
The value type is Integer.

section.title: public static final String USB_BINTERFACEPROTOCOL = "usbinfo.bInterfaceProtocol"
section.para: Service property for USB Interface Descriptor field "bInterfaceProtocol".
The value type is String; the value is in 2-digit hexadecimal. For example, "ff".

section.title: public static final String USB_BINTERFACESUBCLASS = "usbinfo.bInterfaceSubClass"
section.para: Service property for USB Interface Descriptor field "bInterfaceSubClass".
The value type is String; the value is in 2-digit hexadecimal. For example, "ff".

section.title: public static final String USB_BMAXPACKETSIZE0 = "usbinfo.bMaxPacketSize0"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "bMaxPacketSize0".
The value type is Integer. This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_BNUMCONFIGURATIONS = "usbinfo.bNumConfigurations"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "bNumConfigurations".
The value type is Integer. This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_BNUMENDPOINTS = "usbinfo.bNumEndpoints"
section.para: Service property for USB Interface Descriptor field "bNumEndpoints".
The value type is Integer. This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_BUS = "usbinfo.bus"
section.para: Service property to identify USB bus.

Used to identify USB devices with same VID / PID. The value is the ID of the USB bus assigned when connecting the USB device. The USB bus ID is an integer and does not change while the USB device remains connected. The value type is Integer.

section.title: public static final String USB_IDPRODUCT = "usbinfo.idProduct"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "idProduct".
The value type is String; the value is in 4-digit hexadecimal. For example, "8372".

section.title: public static final String USB_IDVENDOR = "usbinfo.idVendor"
section.para: Service property for USB Device Descriptor field "idVendor".
The value type is String; the value is in 4-digit hexadecimal. For example, "0403".

section.title: public static final String USB_INTERFACE = "usbinfo.Interface"
section.para: Service property for name referenced by USB Interface Descriptor field "iInterface".
The value type is String. This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_MANUFACTURER = "usbinfo.Manufacturer"
section.para: Service property for name referenced by USB Device Descriptor field "iManufacturer".
The value type is String. For example, "Buffalo Inc.". This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_PRODUCT = "usbinfo.Product"
section.para: Service property for name referenced by USB Device Descriptor field "iProduct".
The value type is String. For example, "USB2.0 PC Camera". This service property is optional.

section.title: public static final String USB_SERIALNUMBER = "usbinfo.SerialNumber"
section.para: Service property for name referenced by USB Device Descriptor field "iSerialNumber".
The value type is String. For example, "57B0002600000001". This service property is optional.
